review_summary: Question 7 (Operational Amplifiers and Sensing Circuits) verified with PASS across all 3 leaves (a), (b), and (c). Leaf (a) verifies the potential divider calculation for an op-amp comparator where V_OUT changes sign when non-inverting potential V+ equals inverting potential V-: reading thermistor resistance R_T = 3.2 kΩ at 4.0 °C from Fig. 7.2 (C1) and equating bridge ratios R / R_T = 2.4 / 1.8 to determine resistance R = (2.4 / 1.8) * 3.2 = 4.3 kΩ (A1). Leaf (b) verifies the qualitative comparator analysis at θ = 2.5 °C: reading R_T = 3.37 kΩ (or noting R_T > 3.2 kΩ) (B1), deducing that increased R_T raises the non-inverting input potential above the inverting input potential such that V+ > V- (M1), and concluding that the comparator saturates at positive supply V_OUT = +5.0 V (A1). Leaf (c) verifies the output LED indicator design on Fig. 7.1: drawing correct LED symbols with emission arrows (B1), connecting two LEDs in parallel between V_OUT and earth (0 V) with opposite polarities (M1), and correctly orienting LED G pointing from V_OUT to earth (forward-biased at +5.0 V below 4.0 °C) and LED B pointing from earth to V_OUT (forward-biased at -5.0 V above 4.0 °C) consistent with part (b) (A1). All progressive hints, teacher walkthroughs, AI rubrics, deterministic checks, and taxonomy mappings are fully compliant.
